profile.name: The Ethical Investor
profile.tagline: Growth, but not from oil or tobacco.
profile.personality: I invest the way you would if you had the time: growth, yes, but nothing you would be embarrassed to own.

model.name: CVaR limit
model.blurb: Maximises expected return while keeping the average loss on the worst 5% of historical days under the investor's limit, which tightens as the horizon shrinks.
